question: T.H. Vinayakram received the Grammy award for his participation in Mickey Hart's Album titled ________ in the category of Best Music Album where he played both, Ghatam and Morsing.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Planet of Drums".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Planet of Drum **is an American group of Drum and Bass artists.
 
• This group was founded in the summer of 2000.
 
• The Planet of the Drums created dramatic **science fiction-style audio.**
 
• This is a music album by Mickey Hart.
 
• The concept of this group was to play drum music with percussionists from different parts of the world to produce musical styles and traditions into the sound.
 
• Planet of drums is a **two-time grammy award-winning group.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **T.H. Vinayakram** is an Indian percussionist. He plays Carnatic music with an earthen pot.
 
• He is the **first South Indian musician** awarded a grammy for best world music album for his performance in Mickey Hart's Planet Drum.
 
• He is known as the** 'Master of Ghatam'**.
 
• **Mysterium Tremendum** is an album by the Mickey Hart Band and this music is played along with what Hart has called 'cosmic sounds'. These sounds were created by electromagnetic radiations given by Sun, moon, etc and this sound was transformed by using computers.
 
• **At the Edge **is a band from South California.
